text_block_list.text:
—With the Tenno Sho (Spring) just around the corner,
the track was buzzing with excitement, centered around a certain Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
I must maintain top speed for longer...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...McQueen-san is amazing.
Even though she's already more than fast enough.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Still seeking more strength, huh...?
Man, this year's Tenno Sho (Spring) is really gonna be...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Haaah... I'm starting to lose confidence.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eep!? Wh-What!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "I-I'm okay... Rice... Rice has to be able to do this."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Because we're rivals.
That night—
(*knock knock*)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me...
M-My name is Zenno Rob Roy...
choice_data_list: You were cheering for Rice Shower, weren't you—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! And so, um――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Have you seen Rice Shower anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Actually, she hasn't returned to her room yet.
Even though it's already roll call time...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Big brother... and Rob Roy...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Big sister... and Rob Roy...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...I-I'm sorry.
But..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I'm sorry.
I'll make sure to get some proper rest."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Rice-san.
This is your Big Brother, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Rice-san.
This is your Big Sister, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um... you're always so kind, like the destined person from that picture book—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
H-Hyaa!? Rob Roy-san!?
Shh! Shh...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't stay quiet!
I'm cheering for you too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Rob Roy-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Even that blue rose couldn't have
bloomed all on its own."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If something is troubling you...
I believe you should properly consult someone about it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...*sniffle*. B-But... I'm scared...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If I ask someone for help, they might figure it out, right...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Even though you had high hopes for Rice,
Rice was thinking that maybe it's just impossible for her..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice doesn't want to make anyone unhappy anymore...
I don't want to disappoint anyone ever again...!
choice_data_list: There's no way I'd think that.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right! Me too!
I won't be disappointed at all!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure everyone cheering for you
feels the exact same way, Rice-san!
choice_data_list: So don't try to handle it all on your own.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Big Brother...!
*sniff*... *sob*...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Big Sister...!
*sniff*... *sob*...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, uwaaaaaaahhh~~!
McQueen-san was just sooo strong~...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
“But... Rice wants to, Rice wants to too...!!
I want to get stronger, much, much stronger...!”

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaaaaahhh!

Like a broken dam,
large tears began to pour uncontrollably
from Rice Shower's eyes.
—And the next day.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: R-Rice-san! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...U-Uuu...
Are you sure it'll really be okay...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm totally fine!
Come on, Trainer, cheer for me too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y... Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...So, would it be alright if I began moving now?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hyawa!? I-I'm so sorry!
Bourbon-san... um, er, ah...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Please, save Rice!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...? Has a discrepancy occurred
in our communication?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-It is not! Because
I have business with Bourbon-san!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"You might be disappointed to hear this, but...
Rice really needs someone to save her
right now!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice is still too weak right now, and at this rate,
I won't stand a chance against McQueen-san...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So I want Bourbon-san to teach me how to run, too!
Give me everything I'm missing!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: I want you to believe in the miracle Rice Shower will make happen.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If that is a necessary step
toward the greatest race in history...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Application received. Updating schedule.
Approved Rice-san's participation in 10 sets of
slope training this afternoon as Phase 1.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Objective: Increase muscular strength and speed.
If additional load is required,
I will execute the lending of specialized anklets.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am aware that some refer to my training as
"demonic," but—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Can you keep up? Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

And they took off running.
Toward the Tenno Sho (Spring), which would soon be upon them—!
